data.title: Show HN: Elelem, a tool-calling CLI for Ollama and DeepSeek in C
data.author: atjamielittle
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Elelem，一个基于C语言的命令行聊天客户端，支持AI模型通过工具调用系统执行实际操作。它提供了安装指南、构建步骤以及使用不同API（如DeepSeek和Ollama）的配置方法。Elelem支持多种工具，如文件搜索、代码分析、文件操作和系统命令执行，用户可以通过交互命令控制会话和工具使用。文章详细列出了工具的功能、使用示例以及核心代码架构，展示了如何在不同场景下利用AI执行任务。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：工具调用功能及其潜在风险

不同观点：
• **对工具调用功能的担忧**：abeyer表达了对工具调用功能的担忧，特别是将其与MCP（可能指某种复杂系统或协议）进行类比。他们认为工具调用功能可能会带来类似于MCP的风险，尤其是还伴随内存安全漏洞的问题。这暗示了对引入新功能可能带来的技术债务和安全隐患的警惕。

• **对新功能的态度**：尽管评论的语气略带讽刺，但也可以看出abeyer对新功能（工具调用）持谨慎态度。这种观点可能代表了一部分开发者对新技术或新功能快速引入的保守立场，尤其是在安全性尚未得到充分验证的情况下。

补充讨论：
• **内存安全漏洞**：评论特别提到了内存安全漏洞，这是许多编程语言和系统中常见的严重问题。abeyer认为工具调用功能可能会增加这种风险，显示出对系统稳定性和安全性的关注。

• **类比MCP的风险**：通过将工具调用功能与MCP类比，评论者暗示了对复杂系统中潜在问题的深刻认识。这种类比可能意味着对复杂系统中相互依赖的功能模块间的潜在漏洞和风险的担忧。

• **争议焦点**：争议的焦点在于工具调用功能是否真的会引入类似MCP的风险以及内存安全问题。部分开发者可能认为新功能带来的好处大于风险，而另一部分开发者则可能持谨慎态度，强调需要更多的安全验证和测试。

README.md
Elelem
Chat Client with Tool-Calling Support
An interactive C-based command-line chat client that enables AI models to execute real-world actions through a comprehensive tool-calling system.
🚀
Quick Start
Prerequisites
Ubuntu/Debian:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install build-essential libglib2.0-dev libjson-glib-dev libsoup2.4-dev libreadline-dev
Fedora/RHEL:
sudo dnf install gcc glib2-devel json-glib-devel libsoup-devel readline-devel
macOS:
brew install glib json-glib libsoup readline pkg-config
Building
git clone <your-repo-url>
cd
gobject
make clean
&&
make
Setup API Keys
For DeepSeek API:
export
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
=
"sk-your-key-here"
For Ollama (local):
# Install and start Ollama
curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh
|
sh
ollama serve
# Pull a model (in another terminal)
ollama pull qwen3
📖
Usage
Basic Commands
# Start with DeepSeek (requires API key)
./elelem
# Use Ollama with specific model
./elelem -p ollama -m qwen3
# Use custom Ollama server
./elelem -p ollama -u http://remote-server:11434 -m mistral
Interactive Commands
Command
Description
Example
/tools
List available tools
/tools
/history
Show conversation history
/history
/save
Save current conversation
/save
/load <file>
Load previous conversation
/load conversations/chat_2024-01-01_10-30-00.txt
/model <name>
Switch AI model
/model llama3.1
/provider <name>
Switch between providers
/provider ollama
/clear
Clear conversation history
/clear
/exit
Exit application
/exit
🛠️
Available Tools
The AI can execute these tools to help you:
🔍
Search Tools
grep
- Search for patterns in files recursively
Required:
pattern
Optional:
path
,
file_pattern
,
case_sensitive
analyze_code
- Analyze code structure and metrics
Optional:
path
(default: current),
language
(default: c)
📁
File Tools
read_file
- Read and display file contents
Required:
filename
write_file
- Create or modify files
Required:
filename
,
content
list_directory
- Browse directory contents
Optional:
path
(default: current directory)
💻
System Tools
shell
- Execute shell commands (sandboxed for safety)
Required:
command
💡
Example Interactions
Code Analysis
> Analyze this codebase and tell me about its structure
[AI will use the analyze_code tool to examine your project, count lines of code, identify functions, and provide architectural insights]
File Search
> Find all TODO comments in C files
[AI will use grep tool with pattern "TODO" and file_pattern "*.c" to search recursively through your codebase]
File Operations
> Create a new header file called "utils.h" with basic includes
[AI will use write_file tool to create the header file with appropriate content]
System Operations
> What's in the current directory and what's the git status?
[AI will use list_directory and shell tools to show directory contents and run "git status"]
🏗️
Architecture
Core Components
main.c
- CLI interface and main event loop
llm_interface.[ch]
- Abstract client interface
deepseek_client.[ch]
- DeepSeek API implementation
ollama_client.[ch]
- Ollama local API implementation
tool_manager.[ch]
- Tool orchestration system
tool_definition.[ch]
- Tool schema definit

data.author: paulpauper
data.article_summary: 文章指出，美国曾拥有世界上最大的监狱系统，但近年来监狱人口显著下降。2009年，美国监狱人口达到约160万的峰值，而到2023年底已降至120万，预计未来将减至60万，降幅约60%。这种变化主要源于20世纪后期犯罪率上升导致的严苛刑罚，尽管犯罪率自1990年代起下降，但长刑期和累犯现象使监狱人口长期居高不下。如今，随着青少年犯罪率大幅下降，新一代犯罪率降低，监狱人口持续减少。预计到2035年，监禁率可能降至每10万人中200人，这将大幅减少监狱系统的规模和开支。

44379670.article_content:
For more than 40 years, the United States—a nation that putatively cherishes freedom—has had one of the largest prison systems in the world. Mass incarceration has been so persistent and pervasive that reform groups dedicated to
reducing the prison population by half
have often been derided as made up of fantasists. But the next decade could see this goal met and exceeded: After peaking at just more than 1.6 million Americans in 2009, the prison population was
just more than 1.2 million at the end of 2023
(the most recent year for which data are available), and is on track to fall to about 600,000—a decline of roughly 60 percent.
Discerning the coming prison-population cliff requires understanding the relationship between crime and incarceration over generations. A city jail presents a snapshot of what happened last night (for example, the crowd’s football-victory celebration turned ugly). But a prison is a portrait of what happened five, 10, and 20 years ago. Middle-aged people who have been law-abiding their whole life until “something snapped” and they committed a terrible crime are a staple of crime novels and movies, but in real life, virtually everyone who ends up in prison starts their criminal career in their teens or young adulthood. As of 2016—the most recent year for which data are available—the average man in state prison had been arrested
nine times, was currently incarcerated for his sixth time, and was serving a 16-year sentence
.
Because of that fundamental dynamic, the explanation for why roughly 1.6 million people—more than 500 for every 100,000 Americans—were in a state or federal prison in 2009 has very little to do with what was happening on the streets or with law-enforcement policies that year. Rather, the causes lay in the final decades of the 20th century.
From the end of World War II until the mid-1970s, the proportion of Americans in prison each year
never exceeded 120 per 100,000
. But starting in the late 1960s, a multidecade crime wave swelled in America, and an unprecedented number of adolescents and young adults were criminally active. In response, the anti-crime policies of most local, state, and federal governments became more and more draconian. The combined result was that the prison population exploded. By 1985, the imprisonment rate had doubled from its historical norm, such that
more than 200 in 100,000 Americans were in a state or federal prison
. The number of people in prison increased
an average of 8 percent a year for the next decade
, breaching the
1 million mark in 1994
and continuing to grow until 2009. This had ramifications that were felt for years: Because
most people who are released from prison return
, the system has been stocked and restocked with the legacy of that American crime-and-punishment wave for a quarter century. That’s why the 2009 peak of U.S. imprisonment came 18 years after the 1991 peak in the violent-crime rate. The prison system is like a badly overloaded tractor trailer—it takes a long time to stop even after the brakes are hit.
David A. Graham: The good news about crime
That tractor trailer is finally slowing down, decades after the
“great crime decline”
began in the 1990s. Until 2009, the lengthier sentences handed down during the preceding crime wave and the tendency of released prisoners to be re-incarcerated kept imprisonment rising even as crime declined. But the falling crime that the U.S. experienced in the 1990s and 2000s is now finally translating into a shrinking prison population.
This chart, using data from the U.S. Department of Justice, shows the collapse of criminal arrests of minors in the 21st century. Rapidly declining numbers of youth are committing crimes, getting arrested, and being incarcerated. This matters because young offenders are the raw material that feeds the prison system: As one generation ages out, another takes its place on the same horrid journey. The U.S. had an extremely high-crime generation followed by a lower-crime generation, meaning that the older population is not being replaced at an equal rate. The impact of this shift on the prison population began more than a decade ago but has been little noticed because it takes so long for the huge prison population of longer provenance to clear.
But such a transformation is now well under way. One statistic vividly illustrates the change: In 2007, the imprisonment rate for 18- and 19-year-old men was more than five times that of men over the age of 64. But today, men in those normally crime-prone late-adolescent years are imprisoned at half the rate that senior citizens are today.
As the snake digests the pig year after year, the American prison system is simply not going to have enough inmates to justify its continued size or staggering costs. Some states that are contemplating expanding their prison capacity will be wasting their money—their facilities will be overbuilt and underused. 主要讨论点：iPhone如何备份到外部硬盘以及备份方案的实用性和可行性

不同观点：
• gerdemb对如何将iPhone备份到外部硬盘表示困惑，质疑文章或工具链接的缺失。
• gaudat反驳了NAS设置不现实的观点，推荐使用Synology NAS及其Photos应用，认为这是一种长期有效的解决方案。
• jlarocco表示自己不会使用此类方案，但承认其对家庭成员可能有帮助，个人更倾向于使用ifuse和rsync。
• mfa1999关注备份大型照片库（如15万张照片/视频）的可行性，特别是这些照片是否保存在iCloud中，以及是否能保留相册/文件夹结构。
• SwamyM希望有一种方法可以将iPhone拍摄的照片直接备份到外部硬盘，并对Apple将所有图片混在一起备份表示不满。
• 1970-01-01将该方案与iMazing进行比较，质疑其区别和优势。
• polymatter赞赏提供了一次性“终身”付费选项的方案。
• mindwork提出Immich作为另一种可能的解决方案，指出其可以在Docker容器中本地运行。
• keroro关注该方案的成本问题。
• er0k简单直接地表示使用rsync已经能很好地满足需求。

补充讨论：
• 备份大型照片库的可行性及对文件结构的保留是用户关注的重点。
• 不同用户对NAS方案的接受度存在差异，部分用户认为NAS设置不现实，而其他用户则认为特定产品（如Synology NAS）是有效的解决方案。
• 一次性“终身”付费选项被部分用户视为一个重要的优点。
• 用户提出了多个备选方案，如iMazing、Immich和rsync，显示出对多样化选择的需求。
• 成本问题是用户关注的另一焦点，部分用户明确询问了方案的价格。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于NAS方案是否现实以及是否比其他备份方案（如iMazing、Immich、rsync）更具优势。用户对不同方案的实用性和成本效益有不同看法。

data.title: Deep Down the Rabbit Hole: Bash, OverlayFS, and a 30-Year-Old Surprise
data.author: Deeg9rie9usi
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了一次涉及Bash、OverlayFS及30年前遗留问题的调试过程。最初，客户报告在切换到OverlayFS后，OpenSSH的scp命令失败，错误信息显示为"shell-init: error retrieving current directory: getcwd: cannot access parent directories: Inappropriate ioctl for device"。调查发现，该问题源于Bash使用了自定义的getcwd()函数，而非glibc提供的版本。这是因为在交叉编译环境中，系统错误地认为getcwd()存在问题，导致Bash回退到古老的实现。该实现与OverlayFS不兼容，导致错误。最终，通过模拟Yocto项目中的处理方法，明确声明getcwd()行为，问题得以解决。根本原因在于OverlayFS的某些特性与Bash过时的getcwd()实现不匹配。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：POSIX API中关于errno和相关文件系统问题的复杂性及其历史遗留bug的讨论

不同观点：
• chubot认为POSIX API在errno处理上令人困惑，99%的情况下不需要手动设置errno，但在某些情况下（如readdir()返回NULL表示错误或EOF时）却需要。他提到在Oils项目中发现并修复了与$PWD相关的长期未修复的bug，并指出shell不能简单依赖getcwd()来处理符号链接问题。

• JonChesterfield对邮件列表中针对该bug的回应感到失望。他认为修复方法是设置errno=0以确保错误信息合理，但得到的回应却是对文件系统工作方式的质疑，而非感谢或确认修复。

• justincormack指出，许多configure脚本中的检查已经过时，在诸如交叉编译的情况下容易出问题。他认为很多检查在现代系统中不适用，并提到Nix在2017年已经禁用了某些检查。

• saurik强调在交叉编译时应更加注意，不能依赖默认设置和忽略警告，而应手动提供autoconf所需的信息或在目标系统上运行测试，以确保正确性。

• malkia认为autoconf虽然表面上看起来容易使用，但实际上可能会导致难以解开的复杂问题。他主张限制配置集，针对特定平台进行编译，以避免不确定的主机环境猜测。

• jwilk提供了公开的bug报告链接，以便进一步查阅相关讨论。

• pogopop77认为这个讨论展示了新范式（如overlay文件系统）如何微妙地影响复杂的行为，并对此进行了有趣的探讨。

• akoboldfrying以幽默方式提醒大家注意复杂的环境问题，如$PANTS_BROKEN和$SOLARIS。

• x0x0总结认为，软件的复杂性在于历史遗留的语义问题，如inode编号的变化导致支持overlay文件系统时需要改变软件行为，而许多软件尚未升级。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：POSIX API中errno处理的复杂性以及在不同情况下的正确做法。
• 历史遗留bug的修复与维护问题，尤其是跨时代系统的兼容性。
• 交叉编译中的挑战及如何正确处理不同系统环境下的配置与编译问题。

Deep Down the Rabbit Hole: Bash, OverlayFS, and a 30-Year-Old Surprise
This blog post recounts a recent debugging session that uncovered a surprising set of issues involving Bash,
getcwd()
1
, and OverlayFS
2
.
What began as a simple customer bug report evolved into a deep dive worth sharing.
Initial Bug Report
A customer reported that OpenSSH scp
3
failed after switching to OverlayFS.
We found the following error in the logs:
shell-init: error retrieving current directory: \
getcwd: cannot access parent directories: Inappropriate ioctl for device
After analyzing the report, we realized the message didn’t come from scp itself but from the Bash shell.
We asked the key question: why couldn’t Bash determine the current working directory, and why did it fail with
ENOTTY
(Inappropriate ioctl for device)?
Ruling Out the Kernel
Because the issue appeared after the introduction of OverlayFS, we reviewed the OverlayFS source code in the Linux kernel for any code paths that return
ENOTTY
.
Although such paths exist, we considered hitting them highly unlikely.
Bash uses glibc and is written in C.
We examined the glibc system call wrapper for
getcwd()
but found no logic that could return
ENOTTY
.
The wrapper mainly handles buffer allocation and falls back to a generic implementation if the system call fails.
To test this theory, we enabled system call tracing.
Surprisingly, the trace revealed that the
getcwd()
system call never got called.
Since glibc offers multiple
getcwd()
implementations depending on the system, we double-checked that we had reviewed the correct Linux-specific one.
We found no code path that bypassed the system call.
Bash’s home made
getcwd()
A hunch led us to check how Bash links to the
getcwd
symbol:
$ nm -D bash | grep getcwd
...
000c7b10 T getcwd
...
This showed that Bash includes its own
getcwd()
function rather than relying on glibc’s version.
We expected this output instead:
$ nm -D bash | grep getcwd
...
U getcwd
...
Surprised, we inspected the Bash source and confirmed it does contain a
getcwd()
implementation, but guarded by the following:
#if !defined (HAVE_GETCWD)
Developers originally intended this fallback for ancient Unix systems lacking the
getcwd()
system call.
On Linux,
HAVE_GETCWD
should normally be defined.
We confirmed in
config.h
:
#define HAVE_GETCWD 1
At first, this puzzled us because under normal conditions, the implementation should never compile.
But further inspection of
config-bot.h
showed this logic:
#if defined (HAVE_GETCWD) && defined (GETCWD_BROKEN) && !defined (SOLARIS)
#  undef HAVE_GETCWD
#endif
Sure enough, our
config.h
defined
GETCWD_BROKEN
.
That explained why Bash used its internal fallback.
But why did the system consider
getcwd()
broken?
Cross-Compilation Confusion
We examined the output of the
configure
script in detail to trace the origin of
GETCWD_BROKEN
.
We found this line:
checking if getcwd() will dynamically allocate memory with 0 size... \
configure: WARNING: cannot check whether getcwd allocates memory when cross-compiling \
-- defaulting to no
The check in
aclocal.m4
sets
GETCWD_BROKEN
if it can’t confirm that
getcwd()
allocates memory with a zero-size buffer.
Since the build occurred in a cross-compilation environment, the test defaulted to failure.
We discovered that Bash becomes problematic in cross-compilation environments.
Since Bash is cross-compiled for ARM in this specific setup, this made sense.
We then wondered why this issue wasn’t more widespread.
After all, both Bash and OverlayFS are common in embedded systems.
Next, we looked into how major embedded Linux projects like Yocto handle cross-compiling Bash.
Although the Bash Yocto recipe didn’t mention
getcwd
, we found this line in
meta/site/common-glibc
:
bash_cv_getcwd_malloc
=
${
bash_cv_getcwd_malloc
=yes
}
Yocto explicitly overrides the test result to avoid the fallback.
The embedded Linux build system we used didn’t apply such a workaround.
This clarified the issue.
After we implemented a similar override, the issue vanished.
Root Cause Analysis
At this point, we had identified and fixed the bug.
But several questions remained:
Why did the issue appear only with OverlayFS?
Why did Bash’s fallback
getcwd()
fail?
During testing, we observed another error message:
shell-init: error retrieving current directory: \
getcwd: cannot access parent directories: Success
This indicated that
errno
was sometimes set to
0
, suggesting no error occurred, yet
getcwd()
still failed.
OverlayFS and Inode Numbers
To answer the remaining questions, we analyzed Bash’s
getcwd()
implementation.
On Linux, you can determine the current working directory in two ways:
Use the
getcwd()
system call
Read the
/proc/self/cwd
symlink
Bash’s implementation used neither, aiming to support systems lacking these features.
In fact, the fallback dates back to the last millennium.
It used a classic Unix algorithm to reconstruct the working directory path:
I

44379620.article_content:
OSes
9
Microsoft dangles extended Windows 10 support in exchange for Reward Points
9
Or your cloud-bound soul. Otherwise, $30 please
Liam Proven
Wed 25 Jun 2025
//
13:35 UTC
Microsoft has found a new use for Reward Points – and another incentive to upload everything you hold dear to someone else's servers.
You know the drill by now. Windows 10 is
approaching its end of life
(although the special LTSC edition has years to go, and we
told you how to get it
a couple of months ago). In April last year,
The Register
described the Extended Security Updates (ESU) program
, and then in October when the scheme was
extended to individual consumers
for a bargain-tastic $30 for one year.
Now the company is widening the ESU entry criteria. A
new blog post
by consumer marketing veep Yusuf Mehdi lays out three ways for consumers to get with the program:
An enrollment wizard will be available through notifications and in Settings, making it easy to enroll in ESU directly from your personal Windows 10 PC. Through the enrollment wizard, you'll be able to choose from three options:
Use Windows Backup to sync your settings to the cloud – at no additional cost.
Redeem 1,000 Microsoft Rewards points – at no additional cost.
Pay $30 USD (local pricing may vary).
The rewards scheme piqued our curiosity, as
The Reg
FOSS desk does in fact have a Microsoft Hotmail account, and has since 1996 or so. We signed into the
Bing Rewards page
excitedly to see how many points we had accrued in nearly three decades. The answer is… 341. At this rate, in just 79 years, we will have enough for a free year of Windows updates! This vulture will also be 14 years older than the
late Jeanne Calment
by then, and sincerely hopes not to be using any version of Windows in 2104.
Slightly more seriously, the Windows Backup option is a good one. Backups are a good thing and you can't have too many of them. The
Windows Backup app
is free and you can use it alongside other backup tools. There is, of course, a slight snag – it backs up to Microsoft OneDrive (the service
formerly known as SkyDrive
). The basic free level of OneDrive storage gives you 5 GB of cloud storage and 15 GB in your inbox. If your files fit into that, good for you. Ours have not for a long time – possibly not long after we opened our Hotmail account.
Windows 11 migration heats up... on desktops
Windows 11 market share stalls ahead of Windows 10 cutoff
The 'End of 10' is nigh, but don't bury your PC just yet
How to stay on Windows 10 instead of installing Linux
So what this really means is that if you're paying for extra OneDrive storage, you (yes,
you,
$CUSTOMER_6845734542
!) qualify for ESU. In many cases, paying for extra OneDrive storage means you're also paying for Microsoft 365, and that means extra updates. The $19.99-a-year plan gets you 100 GB of OneDrive space, and the $99.99-a-year, or $9.99 per month) gets you 1,000 GB.
(What's more, it says here,
Copilot now included
. Don't you try to threaten me, Nadella.)
In summary, if you're paying for Microsoft 365 – likely to get Office 365 – then you get a year more of updates. Joking aside, that's good. The barrel of the gun has lowered slightly, at least for those obedient customers who are paying for extra services over and on top of their OS. Good for them.
If you're not – for example, if you are happy with a much older version of MS Office – then you still might want to investigate the LTSC branch, or just bite the bullet and
switch to Linux
. You can always
dual boot the thing
.
As for commercial users? Life is going to get more expensive for most. Mehdi says they can "subscribe to ESU for $61 USD per device to receive monthly critical and important security updates for one year." This subscription can be renewed annually for a maximum of three years and the cost rises each year.
In terms of cloud and virtual environments? "Windows 10 devices accessing Windows 11 Cloud PCs through Windows 365 or Virtual Machines are entitled to ESU at no additional cost and will automatically receive security updates with no extra steps required." ®
Bootnote
It looks like Mr Mehdi is a true Microsoftie for life. He was blogging about
Windows 10 – The First 24 Hours
a full decade ago, but the first mention we can find of him on
The Reg
is from
way back in 1999
. That's good going.

data.title: Information has been permanently deleted, for small values of permanently
data.author: Tomte
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：数据删除的真实性和可验证性

不同观点：
• **lrvick**：认为可以通过技术手段实现可验证的数据删除，例如通过端到端加密和安全 enclave 技术。其公司提供相关咨询服务，并建议未来需要类似于 TLS 绿色锁的隐私认证标准。预计实现需要20年时间。
• **JohnFen**：对公司声称的数据删除持不信任态度，因为无法验证，且存在公司欺骗行为。其策略是尽量减少他人掌握的数据量。
• **clickety_clack**：用讽刺的语气指出，数据删除的定义通常隐藏在复杂且不透明的用户协议中，用户难以明确理解。
• **codeplea**：质疑公司声称数据删除的自相矛盾性，并指出公司可能因法律要求保留某些数据，例如发票。
• **SoftTalker**：认为公司可能仅保留邮件列表中的邮件地址，而不保留其他个人信息，但也不能完全排除保留个人信息的可能性。
• **midtake**：解释邮件列表通常与主用户数据库分离管理，可能是由于这种分离导致邮件继续发送，而非有意保留个人信息。
• **nitwit005**：认为保留联系信息用于法律通信是合理的，否则公司无法通知用户数据已被删除。
• **therobot24**：指出由于缺乏实际执法，公司缺乏说实话的动力。感叹个人数据被大量采集和商业化。
• **ecshafer**：指出许多数据库通过标记“is_deleted”来实现“删除”，实际数据仍保留在磁盘上，只是在查询中被忽略。
• **andrewflnr**：倾向于认为数据保留可能是由于 incompetence 而非恶意。可能是不同部门数据库管理不一致或不规范导致的问题。

补充讨论：
• **kps**：对讨论标题有误解，以为是物理学上的突破，结果是关于数据删除的技术讨论。
• **Mystery-Machine**：对发帖者身份（微软员工）表示兴趣，暗示可能有公司背景影响其观点。
• **petercooper**：提到 GDPR 的“被遗忘权”有各种条件和例外，例如需要保留某些数据以备法律需求，并指出公司可能在解释法规时过于 eager，导致更新用户政策时显得不必要。

争议焦点：
• 数据删除的真实性和可验证性。
• 公司声称数据删除的自相矛盾和不透明性。
• 数据保留的法律要求和用户隐私之间的平衡。
• 技术 incompetence 与恶意保留数据的可能性。

data.title: Cracking the Mondrian Code (2017)
data.author: jstrieb
data.article_summary:
文章主要讲述了荷兰画家彼埃·蒙德里安（Piet Mondrian）的未完成作品《胜利布吉伍吉》（Victory Boogie Woogie）。这是他生前投入超过一年时间创作的最后一幅重要画作，直至因病去世时仍未完成。蒙德里安在生命的最后十天里，尽管身患重病，仍专注于这幅作品，用彩色胶带不断调整画面。他去世后，艺术史学家和评论家将这幅钻石形画布视为其最后的伟大未竟之作。

多年来，人们试图推测这幅画如果完成会是什么样子，有人基于色彩逻辑公式或数学算法提出假设，但博物馆馆长汉斯·詹森（Hans Janssen）指出，蒙德里安的作品其实是直觉性的，无法用公式解码。文章还探讨了未完成艺术作品的魅力，以及它们在文化传承中的特殊地位。

44350135.article_content:
Logger
Cracking the Mondrian Code
by Nina Siegal
December 18th, 2017
Share
Share via Facebook
Share via Twitter
Copy link to clipboard
Share via text message
When the artist Piet Mondrian died in the winter of 1944 at the age of 71, he was in the midst of working on a painting he had told people would be the definitive expression of his aesthetic ideals. The work, entitled “Victory Boogie Woogie,” in homage to American jazz, had absorbed his entire focus for more than a year.
In the last ten days of his life, while suffering from acute bronchitis, he worked on the painting to the exclusion of all else, tacking onto the canvas small squares of colored tape, ignoring his rapidly declining health. He worked until he collapsed. Friends discovered him passed out in his studio and rushed him to the hospital where, a few days later, he died of pneumonia. Art historians and critics have since called the diamond-shaped canvas covered in tiny pieces of colored tape that he’d left behind on the easel Mondrian’s last great, unfinished masterpiece.
Almost immediately afterward, and for more than seventy years since, people have tried to figure out what the painting would have looked like if Mondrian had finished it. Over the years, Mondrian friends and aficionados have proposed various final versions of the painting, sometimes based on color-charted logical formulas or mathematical algorithms, and artists have made lots of copies, hoping to both preserve the image, and to explore its logic. Once every few weeks, the Gemeentemuseum, which owns the largest collection of Mondrian works anywhere in the world, still receives an email or letter from someone who claims to have discovered the mathematical proof that would solve “Victory Boogie Woogie.”
“They all break down somewhere,” says Hans Janssen, chief curator of the Gemeentemuseum, and author of a groundbreaking biography of Mondrian,
Piet Mondriaan: Een nieuwe kunst voor een ongekend leven [A New Art for a Life Unknown]
. “The reason is—and this is what no one understands about Mondrian—that all his work was intuitive.”
This year, the Netherlands has been celebrating the 100th anniversary of De Stijl, the art, architecture and design movement founded in 1917 by Theo van Doesburg, whose fine art component was refined by Mondrian, a key participant in the movement, which was also known as Neoplasticism. In his essay, “Neo-Plasticism in Pictorial Art,” van Doesburg suggested that art should jettison “natural form and color,” “ignore the particulars of appearance,” and instead “find its expression in the abstraction of form and color.”
“Victory Boogie Woogie” was supposed to become the consummate expression of Mondrian’s aesthetic ideals. In mid-May 1942, he told his then-girlfriend, American artist and journalist Charmion von Wiegand, “Last night I dreamed a new composition.” He was in a state of excitement, she remembered in a 1961 article, and showed her a sketch of the work.
By January 1943, he was working on it to the exclusion of all else. Von Wiegand recalls asking him then, why he “had not made a series of paintings rather than a continuously changing composition of ‘Victory Boogie Woogie.’ … ‘Why, Mondrian, it seems to me as if you have twelve pictures buried under this one canvas.’ He replied: ‘It is not important to make many pictures but that I have one picture right.’”
THE QUESTION OF UNFINISHEDNESS
That wonderfully evocative phrase, “Last Great Unfinished Masterpiece” brings to mind symphonies, cathedrals, and other projects of vast ambition that exceed the bounds of a single individual’s natural life: the splintered spires of Antoni Gaudí’s sandcastle-like Sagrada Família cathedral in Barcelona, only fifteen percent complete when its architect was killed in a trolley accident; Alban Berg’s 20th century operatic masterpiece, “Lulu,” whose third act wasn’t completed until fifty years after his death; Mozart dictating his final deathbed phrases of his “Requiem” to his rival, Salieri (courtesy the imagination of Milos Foreman).
Such works, suddenly abandoned by their creators, are the cherished orphans of our cultural heritage. Once their maker has departed, they remain in aesthetic purgatory, on some undetermined spot in the infinite line between conception and achievement. They enchant us, at least in part, because around them we can still smell the lingering sulfuric burnt-match scent of creative sparks.
“The last works of artists and their unfinished pictures,” wrote the Roman author and natural philosopher Pliny the Elder, “are more admired than those which they finished, because in them are seen the preliminary drawings left visible and the artists’ actual thoughts, and in the midst of approval’s beguilement we feel regret that the artist’s hand while engaged in the work was removed by death.”
The question of Mondrian’s unfinishedness lingers. How close was he to completion? Did he intend to wrap it all up neatly before he died, or was the unfinishedness i

多年来，人们试图推测这幅画如果完成会是什么样子，有人基于色彩逻辑公式或数学算法提出假设，但博物馆馆长汉斯·詹森（Hans Janssen）指出，蒙德里安的作品其实是直觉性的，无法用公式解码。文章还探讨了未完成艺术作品的魅力，以及它们在文化传承中的特殊地位。

data.author: Michelangelo11
data.article_summary: 文章指出，某些与隐私相关的浏览器扩展程序可能会导致在x.com（即推特）上出现问题。建议用户禁用这些扩展程序，然后重试，以解决相关问题。文章强调了隐私扩展与网站功能之间的潜在冲突。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）应用中的上下文管理与简化工具的有效性

不同观点：
• marshyj认为，比起简单的工具包装，上下文工程（context engineering）更为重要。他指出，从LLM中获得好的结果需要考虑很多因素，而目前的许多产品仅通过GPT包装器进行过度简化。即便是设置良好的评估机制，通常也是一个复杂的任务。

• nico强调了上下文管理在当前AI辅助开发中的重要性，认为除了模型能力之外，管理上下文是关键。虽然像Cursor这样的工具试图为用户自动化上下文管理，但在达到一定复杂度后，用户仍需主动参与管理。nico还提到，一些在代理编程中取得良好结果的人，往往非常注重管理他们的规则或配置文件（如cursor rules或claude.md文件）。

补充讨论：
• marshyj和nico都认同在复杂场景中，自动化的工具（如GPT包装器）不足以替代人工的上下文管理。
• nico指出，即便工具可以在一定程度上自动化某些任务，但要获得最佳结果，用户仍需投入精力进行精细管理。
• 争议的焦点在于工具自动化的限度以及人工干预的必要性，尤其是在处理复杂任务和需要高精度结果时。

总结：讨论围绕LLM应用中上下文管理的重要性展开，强调了在工具自动化与人工干预之间的平衡问题。

data.title: Writing toy software is a joy
data.author: bundie
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了编写“玩具软件”（toy software）的乐趣和益处，强调通过亲手创建来加深理解，呼应了理查德·费曼的名言：“我不能创造的，我便不曾理解。” 文章批评了当前软件开发过度商品化、工业化的趋势，提倡通过简单的玩具程序找回编程的乐趣。玩具程序遵循80:20法则，重点不在于构建生产级软件，而是通过简化工程、避免过度设计来学习核心原理。作者分享了自己通过玩具项目获得的意外收获，如在工作中提前识别问题、理解软件约束等。文章还列举了一些玩具项目示例及其难度和所需时间，如正则表达式引擎、x86操作系统内核、GameBoy/NES模拟器等，鼓励开发者通过实践提升技能。

不同观点：
• **支持LLMs作为学习工具**：dakiol认为LLMs是一个有用的工具，可以快速获取信息并提供参考链接，避免依赖错误信息。LLMs帮助节省搜索时间，特别是在需要快速概览时非常有效。
• **反对过度依赖LLMs**：purplesyringa警告不要让LLMs剥夺了从错误中学习的机会。通过尝试、失败、再研究的过程才能真正理解问题，并认为LLMs无法替代这个学习过程。
• **LLMs的正确使用方式**：oconnor663指出，不应完全拒绝LLMs的帮助，但需要明确所需的帮助类型，将其视作专家朋友一样引导自己，而不是单纯获取答案。

补充讨论：

• **发布玩具项目**：hu3建议将玩具项目发布到GitHub，可能会发现对其他人也有用，并获得反馈。

• **AI对编程的影响**：rubicon33和josefresco提到AI正在改变编程的乐趣，强调通过玩具项目找回编程的初心和乐趣。

争议焦点：
• **LLMs是否剥夺了学习过程的乐趣和价值**：一方认为LLMs加速了学习过程，另一方担心其剥夺了从错误中学习的机会。

Writing Toy Software Is A Joy

Writing Toy Software Is A Joy
Why you should write more toy programs
2025-06-15
|
↩️
10
│
🔄
18
│
⭐
36
I am a huge fan of Richard Feyman’s famous quote:
“What I cannot create, I do not understand”
I think it’s brilliant, and it remains true across many fields (if you’re willing to be a little creative with the
definition of ‘create’). It is to this principle that I believe I owe everything I’m truly good at. Some will tell you
to avoid reinventing the wheel, but they’re wrong: you
should
build your own wheel, because it’ll teach you more about
how they work than reading a thousand books on them ever will.
In 2025, the beauty and craft of writing software is being eroded. AI is threatening to replace us (or, at least, the
most joyful aspects of our craft) and software development is being increasingly commodified, measured, packaged, and
industrialised. Software development needs more simple joy, and I’ve found that creating toy programs is a great way to
remember why I started working with computers again.
Keep it simple
Toy programs follow the 80:20 rule: 20% of the work, 80% of the functionality. The point is
not
to build
production-worthy software (although it is true that some of the best production software began life as a toy).
Aggressively avoid over-engineering, restrict yourself to only whatever code is necessary to achieve your goal. Have
every code path panic/crash until you’re forced to implement it to make progress. You might be surprised by just how
easy it is to build toy versions of software you might previously have considered to be insummountably difficult to
create.
Other benefits
I’ve been consistently surprised by just how often some arcane nugget of knowledge I’ve acquired when working on a toy
project has turned out to be immensely valuable in my day job, either by giving me a head-start on tracking down a
problem in a tool or library, or by recognising mistakes before they’re made.
Understanding the constraints that define the shape of software is vital for working with it, and there’s no better way
to gain insight into those constraints than by running into them head-first. You might even come up with some novel
solutions!
The list
Here is a list of toy programs I’ve attempted over the past 15 years, rated by difficulty and time required. These
ratings are estimates and assume that you’re already comfortable with at least one general-purpose programming language
and that, like me, you tend to only have an hour or two per day free to write code. Also included are some suggested
resources that I found useful.
Regex engine (difficulty = 4/10, time = 5 days)
A regex engine that can read a POSIX-style regex program and recognise strings that match it. Regex is simple yet
shockingly expressive, and writing a competent regex engine will teach you everything you need to know about using the
language too.
Wikipedia: Regex
x86 OS kernel (difficulty = 7/10, time = 2 months)
A multiboot-compatible OS kernel with a simple CLI, keyboard/mouse driver, ANSI escape sequence support, memory manager,
scheduler, etc. Additional challenges include writing an in-memory filesystem, user mode and process isolation, loading
ELF executables, and supporting enough video hardware to render a GUI.
OS Dev Wiki
GameBoy/NES emulator (difficulty = 6/10, time = 3 weeks)
A crude emulator for the simplest GameBoy or NES games. The GB and the NES are classics, and both have relatively simple
instruction sets and peripheral hardware. Additional challenges include writing competent PPU (video) and PSG (audio)
implementations, along with dealing with some of the more exotic cartridge formats.
GB Dev
NES Dev Wiki
GameBoy Advance game (difficulty = 3/10, time = 2 weeks)
A sprite-based game (top-down or side-on platform). The GBA is a beautiful little console to write code for and there’s
an active and dedicated development community for the console. I truly believe that the GBA is one of the last game
consoles that can be fully and completely understood by a single developer, right down to instruction timings.
Tonc
GBATEK
Physics engine (difficulty = 5/10, time = 1 week)
A 2D rigid body physics engine that implements Newtonian physics with support for rectangles, circles, etc. On the
simplest end, just spheres that push away from one-another is quite simple to implement. Things start to get complex
when you introduce more complex shapes, angular momentum, and the like. Additional challenges include making collision
resolution fast and scaleable, having complex interactions move toward a steady state over time, soft-body interactions,
etc.
Dynamic interpreter (difficulty = 4/10, time = 1-2 weeks)
A tree-walking interpreter for a JavaScript-like language with basic flow control. There’s an unbounded list of extra
things to add to this one, but being able to write programs in my own language still gives me child-like elation. It
feels like a sort of tech

data.title: Ask HN: Anyone using augmented reality, VR, glasses, helmets etc. in industry?
data.author: NewUser76312
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AR/VR技术在各行业中的应用、技术限制与未来发展

不同观点：
• **AR在工业中的实用性**：  
  - isk517认为Hololens 2在质量检查（QC）中提高了工作效率，特别是在钢铁装配的3D模型叠加方面，但AR技术仍只完成了90%，硬件能力接近极限，且大公司对AR的利润持怀疑态度。
  - idkwhattocallme则指出，过去十年的AR设备存在过重、昂贵、易碎、电池续航短等问题，且大多数客户面临内容缺乏的问题，很多场景下使用智能手机更为有效。

• **VR在办公和培训中的局限性**：  
  - edent指出，VR头显在办公室使用时面临健康风险（如共享头显的卫生问题）、设备不适以及部分用户晕动症的问题，且头显使用时很 isolating（孤立），不适合大多数办公场景。
  - jlarocco提到，虽然VR在CAD数据可视化中有潜力，但其带来的价值是否足以让公司为所有员工配备头显仍存疑。
  - burnt-resistor甚至认为VR是一个每十年出现一次的“僵尸类别”，没有实际应用价值。

• **AR/VR设备的舒适性与技术改进**：  
  - j-wags和gavinray讨论了不同AR设备（如Viture Pro XR和Vuzix Z100）的使用体验，指出设备在佩戴舒适性和视野方面的优缺点。
  - quantumquetzal详细分析了AR/VR设备在重量、电池寿命和社会接受度方面的三大障碍，并提到技术正在逐步改进，特别是通过无线流媒体和电池技术的进步。

• **AR/VR在培训和实际操作中的应用**：  
  - spookie提到AR在培训（如消防员培训）中的应用，但指出电池寿命和设备防尘防水性能是主要障碍。
  - ugolino91分享了他们公司通过VR/AR平台帮助工程和建筑公司进行3D BIM审查的案例，但硬件限制仍是一个挑战。
  - curiouscavalier指出，AR/VR技术在培训（如第一响应者和零售业）中有一定应用，但设备的操作可靠性和工作流改变带来的摩擦使得大规模应用仍受限。

补充讨论：
• **未来发展与技术整合**：  
  - 提到了Apple Vision Pro和即将推出的Android XR，这些新设备可能会带来新的创新。
  - codybontecou分享了Nvidia使用Apple Vision Pro进行人机交互和数据收集的案例，显示了AR/VR技术在机器人领域的潜力。

争议焦点：
• **AR/VR设备的实用性与市场接受度**：部分评论者（如isk517和ugolino91）认为AR/VR设备在特定行业中非常有用，但整体市场接受度低，主要是由于硬件限制和市场需求不足。相反，edent和burnt-resistor则认为这些设备在办公和日常使用中不切实际，且市场前景不明朗。

  - jlarocco提到，虽然VR在CAD数据可视化中有潜力，但其带来的价值是否足以让公司为所有员工配备头显仍存疑。
  - burnt-resistor甚至认为VR是一个每十年出现一次的“僵尸类别”，没有实际应用价值。

• **AR/VR设备的舒适性与技术改进**：  
  - j-wags和gavinray讨论了不同AR设备（如Viture Pro XR和Vuzix Z100）的使用体验，指出设备在佩戴舒适性和视野方面的优缺点。
  - quantumquetzal详细分析了AR/VR设备在重量、电池寿命和社会接受度方面的三大障碍，并提到技术正在逐步改进，特别是通过无线流媒体和电池技术的进步。

• **AR/VR在培训和实际操作中的应用**：  
  - spookie提到AR在培训（如消防员培训）中的应用，但指出电池寿命和设备防尘防水性能是主要障碍。
  - ugolino91分享了他们公司通过VR/AR平台帮助工程和建筑公司进行3D BIM审查的案例，但硬件限制仍是一个挑战。
  - curiouscavalier指出，AR/VR技术在培训（如第一响应者和零售业）中有一定应用，但设备的操作可靠性和工作流改变带来的摩擦使得大规模应用仍受限。

补充讨论：
• **未来发展与技术整合**：  
  - 提到了Apple Vision Pro和即将推出的Android XR，这些新设备可能会带来新的创新。
  - codybontecou分享了Nvidia使用Apple Vision Pro进行人机交互和数据收集的案例，显示了AR/VR技术在机器人领域的潜力。

争议焦点：
• **AR/VR设备的实用性与市场接受度**：部分评论者（如isk517和ugolino91）认为AR/VR设备在特定行业中非常有用，但整体市场接受度低，主要是由于硬件限制和市场需求不足。相反，edent和burnt-resistor则认为这些设备在办公和日常使用中不切实际，且市场前景不明朗。

data.title: PlasticList – Plastic Levels in Foods
data.author: homebrewer
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：塑料对食品的污染及其潜在健康影响

不同观点：
• **dredmorbius** 认为塑料研磨器（尤其是内置于调料瓶中的那种）随着使用时间的增加，可能会将塑料颗粒磨入食物中，这是一种不应存在的产品设计。他引用了一个5年前的讨论，并指出在沃尔玛等平台上仍有此类产品销售。

• **any1** 提出食品中的微塑料更多可能来源于工业加工过程，而非包装或家用塑料制品。他以自己在食品加工设备公司工作的经验为例，指出工厂中的塑料粉尘可能通过高压水枪清洗流入海洋，而不是直接进入食品。

• **showerst** 引用了DEHP和DEHT的“安全限量”，并认为即便依赖于含有塑料包装的食品（如RXBars和Sweetgreen），摄入量仍然远低于安全限量，因此不必过度担忧。

• **xnx** 质疑为何塑料污染获得大量关注，而糖分或酒精过量消费等已证实的健康问题却没有得到同等重视。他认为这种关注度不平衡可能导致对潜在健康风险的误解。

• **eestrada** 担心即便是未加工的牛奶也可能含有塑料，因为挤奶机中的塑料管可能会导致牛奶中混入微塑料。

• **dmm** 提出一个历史性的疑问：1920年代的可可粉中为何检测到1930年代才合成的DEHP，质疑这些检测结果的准确性或来源。

• **perrygeo** 对塑料研究持怀疑态度，提到过去关于“人脑中含有塑料勺量微塑料”的研究因方法论问题而被推翻，呼吁对当前研究方法进行审视。

补充讨论：
• **cheeseomlit** 和 **aydyn** 分别对特定食品（如全食品超市的牛排和星巴克的拿铁）中的塑料含量表示惊讶和质疑，并引用PlasticList网站上的数据。

• **cjflog** 介绍了一个名为Laboratory.love的项目，旨在通过众筹方式让消费者选择具体产品进行塑料检测，以推动供应链透明化。

• **krige** 提到几年前新闻中提到的“能分解塑料的微生物”，质疑其后续发展情况，是否因缺乏资金或其他原因而未取得进展。

• **jjani** 指出PlasticList的报告未明确指出容器类型对微塑料含量的影响，认为容器的材质和使用方式（如温度）可能是微塑料产生的主要原因，而非食品本身。

• **LinguaBrowse** 对PlasticList项目获取1952年朝鲜战争口粮中的奶粉样品的方式表示兴趣，并赞赏其对样本保存和运输条件的详细记录。

• **hobo_in_library** 对塑料检测报告中“水中纸质收据”的检测表示困惑，质疑其检测对象的合理性。

争议焦点：塑料污染的真正来源及其对健康的实际影响。一些讨论者认为工业加工过程是主要来源，而非家用塑料制品；另一些人则对研究方法和塑料含量的健康风险表示怀疑。

data.title: MCP is eating the world
data.author: emschwartz
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MCP（Multi-Agent Communication Protocol）的技术价值、应用场景、安全性及其未来前景

不同观点：
• **对MCP的商业宣传持怀疑态度**：[runlaszlorun]、[pabzu] 等人认为，MCP的宣传有过度炒作之嫌，尤其是当推广MCP的公司本身就从该技术中获利时。他们指出，这种"新技术是救世主"的论调并不新鲜，可能只是商业利益驱动下的营销手段。
  
• **MCP的实际应用价值**：[faxmeyourcode] 强调了MCP在企业内部工具集成的价值，尤其是在自动化复杂任务方面，如通过Jira和Confluence的集成加速任务处理。然而，[0x500x79] 则指出MCP并非适用于所有场景，过度推广可能导致误解其适用范围。

• **MCP的技术成熟度与安全性问题**：[wunderwuzzi23] 和 [neuroelectron] 提到，MCP的生态系统尚不成熟，存在安全漏洞和风险，如通过自然语言处理的漏洞可能导致攻击。此外，[Animats] 认为MCP每次交易都需要经过LLM处理，增加了成本。

• **MCP的应用障碍与改进建议**：[cosbgn] 指出，某些公司期望用户自行托管MCP，增加了使用难度。而[dack] 则提出未来MCP的优化方向，如通过AI自动发现和连接服务，简化用户体验。

• **MCP在消费者技术中的局限性**：[klabb3] 认为，MCP在消费者技术领域的影响有限，因为大型B2C公司如Facebook、Twitter等更关注广告收入，而非开放API，这与他们的商业利益相悖。

• **MCP的技术实现与开发者反馈**：[jlowin] 认为MCP的规范复杂且易被误用，如AI生成的代码可能引发误解。此外，[BLanen] 和 [fennecbutt] 对MCP的技术实现提出质疑，认为其本质上只是对现有API的简单包装，且依赖于LLM的概率输出，缺乏保证。

补充讨论：
• **MCP的用户体验问题**：[remram] 分享了使用MCP运行自定义功能的糟糕体验，指出LLM在处理函数调用时存在不一致性，这增加了调试难度。

争议焦点：
• **MCP是否被过度炒作** 及其 **是否适用于所有场景** 是讨论的核心争议点。一方认为MCP带来了实质性的技术进步，尤其在企业工具集成方面；另一方则认为其应用范围有限，且在消费者技术中难以推广，同时存在技术不成熟和安全性问题。

data.title: Rules Clobber Goals
data.author: kolyder
data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了规则相比于目标在行为改变中的重要性。一个单独的行动无法定义你，但持续的选择和行为可以。设定目标容易，实现难，因为动机不稳定。规则帮助排除对动机的依赖，提前做出选择，减少内心争论。将目标转化为具体规则，并与特定时间或事件绑定，能提高坚持的可能性。规则应简单可持续， brutal而短暂的规则不如持久简单的规则有效。规则帮助评估目标的代价，并应认真执行，习惯的累积决定了最终的结果。文章引用詹姆斯·克利尔的《原子习惯》强调了习惯对生活的影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何制定和呈现规则以促进健康生活方式

不同观点：
• Gopalv认为不应滥用规则来强制推行某种纯粹或专制的生活方式。他指出，这种方式可能会让人感到压迫，且难以遵循。
• Gopalv支持CGP Grey的“主题”概念，而不是简单地制定规则。他引用了一个视频链接，其中讨论了用“趋向健康”的主题代替硬性规定（如“吃健康食物”）。这种方法强调逐步改善，而不是严格的规则。

补充讨论：
• Gopalv的观点反映了一种对灵活性和渐进性生活方式改变的偏好，认为这种方式更具可持续性和人性化。
• 引用的CGP Grey视频可能提供了进一步的论据和例子，支持通过设定大方向或主题来引导行为，而不是通过强制性规则来限制行为。
• 争议的焦点可能在于如何平衡规则的必要性与个人自由之间的关系，特别是在促进公共健康和个人选择方面。

44378217.article_content:
Skip to content
Rules Clobber Goals
One workout doesn’t make you an athlete any more than one cigarette makes you a smoker. But you are an accumulation of
your recurring choices and actions
. We set goals to motivate ourselves. But, of course, we’re better at setting goals than reaching them. This is because motivation is fickle.
Rules help remove motivation from the equation. Setting rules can help you make choices in advance. You can’t argue with yourself if a decision was already made.
To transform a goal into a rule, make it highly specific. Tie it to an ultimatum or a cue, like a time of day, place, or preceding event. The fewer decisions involved in following your rule and the more routinized, the more likely it will stick.
Goal
Rule
I want to lose 20 pounds.
No refined carbs in the house.
I want to get fit.
Work out for 30 minutes a day.
Read 20 books this year.
Read 30 minutes a day.
Sleep 8 hours a night.
No screens after 8 p.m.
Don’t abuse rules to force a puritanical or tyrannical lifestyle.
Do what you can sustainably do every day.
A brutal rule you follow for a week is worth less than a simple one you follow for a year.
Living with rules can help you determine the price of a goal and see if you can realistically pay it. Once you commit to a rule, take it deadly seriously. If one of your ethical rules is to never steal or cheat on a partner, why not hold to one of your habitual rules with the same conviction?
“You get what you repeat. Your outcomes are a lagging measure of your habits.”
~James Clear, Atomic Habits (

Haiku SQLite RAG
A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) library on SQLite.
Features
Local SQLite
: No need to run additional servers
Support for various embedding providers
: You can use Ollama, VoyageAI, OpenAI or add your own
Hybrid Search
: Vector search using
sqlite-vec
combined with full-text search
FTS5
, using Reciprocal Rank Fusion
File monitoring
when run as a server automatically indexing your files
Extended file format Support
: Parse 40+ file formats including PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, audio and more. Or add a url!
MCP server
Exposes functionality as MCP tools.
CLI commands
Access all functionality from your terminal
Python client
Call
haiku.rag
from your own python applications.
Installation
uv pip install haiku.rag
By default Ollama (with the
mxbai-embed-large
model) is used for the embeddings.
For other providers use:
VoyageAI
:
uv pip install haiku.rag --extra voyageai
OpenAI
:
uv pip install haiku.rag --extra openai
Configuration
You can set the directories to monitor using the
MONITOR_DIRECTORIES
environment variable (as comma separated values) :
#
Monitor single directory
export
MONITOR_DIRECTORIES=
"
/path/to/documents,/another_path/to/documents
"
If you want to use an alternative embeddings provider (Ollama being the default) you will need to set the provider details through environment variables:
By default:
EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=
"
ollama
"
EMBEDDINGS_MODEL=
"
mxbai-embed-large
"
#
or any other model
EMBEDDINGS_VECTOR_DIM=1024
For VoyageAI:
EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=
"
voyageai
"
EMBEDDINGS_MODEL=
"
voyage-3.5
"
#
or any other model
EMBEDDINGS_VECTOR_DIM=1024
VOYAGE_API_KEY=
"
your-api-key
"
For OpenAI:
EMBEDDINGS_PROVIDER=
"
openai
"
EMBEDDINGS_MODEL=
"
text-embedding-3-small
"
#
or text-embedding-3-large
EMBEDDINGS_VECTOR_DIM=1536
OPENAI_API_KEY=
"
your-api-key
"
Command Line Interface
haiku.rag
includes a CLI application for managing documents and performing searches from the command line:
Available Commands
#
List all documents
haiku-rag list
#
Add document from text
haiku-rag add
"
Your document content here
"
#
Add document from file or URL
haiku-rag add-src /path/to/document.pdf
haiku-rag add-src https://example.com/article.html
#
Get and display a specific document
haiku-rag get 1
#
Delete a document by ID
haiku-rag delete 1
#
Search documents
haiku-rag search
"
machine learning
"
#
Search with custom options
haiku-rag search
"
python programming
"
--limit 10 --k 100
#
Start file monitoring & MCP server (default HTTP transport)
haiku-rag serve
#
--stdio for stdio transport or --sse for SSE transport
All commands support the
--db
option to specify a custom database path. Run
haiku-rag
command
-h
to see additional parameters for a command.
File Monitoring & MCP server
You can start the server (using Streamble HTTP, stdio or SSE transports) with:
#
Start with default HTTP transport
haiku-rag serve
#
--stdio for stdio transport or --sse for SSE transport
You need to have set the
MONITOR_DIRECTORIES
environment variable for monitoring to take place.
File monitoring
haiku.rag
can watch directories for changes and automatically update the document store:
Startup
: Scan all monitored directories and add any new files
File Added/Modified
: Automatically parse and add/update the document in the database
File Deleted
: Remove the corresponding document from the database
MCP Server
haiku.rag
includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes RAG functionality as tools for AI assistants like Claude Desktop. The MCP server provides the following tools:
add_document_from_file
- Add documents from local file paths
add_document_from_url
- Add documents from URLs
add_document_from_text
- Add documents from raw text content
search_documents
- Search documents using hybrid search
get_document
- Retrieve specific documents by ID
list_documents
- List all documents with pagination
delete_document
- Delete documents by ID

(

)
as
client
:
# Create document from text
doc
=
await
client

create_docum

data.title: Maxar launches intelligence service focused on 'persistent monitoring'
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: Maxar Intelligence推出了名为Sentry的新监控产品，旨在提供可操作的地理空间情报，而不仅限于卫星图像。Sentry通过利用公司250多PB的历史高分辨率卫星影像数据和人工智能技术，帮助客户实时监控全球多个地点的动态，识别潜在威胁或异常活动，例如卫星发射前的迹象或自然灾害对能源设施的威胁。该服务可用于能源安全、全球贸易和禁毒等领域，客户可自定义影像采集频率。此外，Maxar正通过与SkyWatch和SkyFi等平台合作，扩大商业伙伴关系，以更广泛地提供卫星数据。同时，Sentry技术已被应用于支持美国情报和国防任务。

44378231.article_content:
High-resolution satellite imagery of an Istanbul, Turkey, airport. Credit: Maxar Intelligence
WASHINGTON — Maxar Intelligence launched a new monitoring product called Sentry, part of a broader effort to move beyond satellite imagery and become a provider of actionable geospatial intelligence.
The company, based in Westminster, Colorado, operates high-resolution imaging satellites. The new monitoring service would provide customers with continuous surveillance capabilities across multiple global locations simultaneously.
“This type of geospatial intelligence would allow a customer to identify an imminent satellite launch before it happens or to estimate potential threats to energy infrastructure following a natural disaster,” said Dan Smoot, CEO of Maxar Intelligence.
With this new service, Maxar is seeking to compete in the higher-value intelligence market as satellite imagery becomes increasingly commoditized.

Sign up

and to receive email from us and our partners. You can opt-out at any time.
Peter Wilczynski, chief product officer at Maxar Intelligence, said one of the company’s competitive advantages lies in its vast historical archive. Sentry taps into the company’s 250-plus petabyte collection of high-resolution satellite imagery spanning more than two decades, using AI to cross-reference current observations with historical patterns and anomalies.
The software platform aggregates data from Maxar’s own satellites as well as partner constellations, including both electro-optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellites.
Sentry’s potential use cases span from energy security to global trade to combating narcotics. Wilczynski cited the example of tracking fentanyl precursors entering the United States. A government agency could direct Maxar to monitor specific ports or airfields in Mexico and the U.S. Once those points of interest are established, satellites are tasked to capture frequent imagery, while the software autonomously flags unusual patterns — such as unexpected cargo volumes or vehicle activity.
The company is offering users the ability to set collection rates — daily, weekly, or monthly — based on the level of insight needed. “So that you can start understanding the movement of material and the patterns of activity over time,” Wilczynski said.
Expanding commercial partnerships
Maxar is also expanding partnerships with Earth intelligence platforms that aggregate imagery from multiple satellite constellations. These partnerships help democratize access to satellite data by reaching customers who might not otherwise have the resources to work directly with satellite operators.
Last year, Maxar signed an agreement with SkyWatch to provide high-resolution imagery through SkyWatch’s platform. This week, the company announced a similar partnership with the Earth intelligence firm SkyFi, giving SkyFi access to Maxar’s high-resolution satellite imagery, 3D terrain data and historical archives.
These agreements reflect broader industry trends as satellite imagery becomes more accessible and companies compete on analytical capabilities rather than raw data collection.
Government demand
The technologies underlying Sentry are already being deployed in programs supporting U.S. intelligence and defense missions through the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency’s Luno program, Wilczynski told
SpaceNews
.
Luno, a
nearly $500 million multi-vendor initiativ
e, aims to leverage commercial geospatial technology for government applications.
Maxar recently secured a task order of undisclosed value under the Luno A program for “rapid identification of aircraft, ships, vehicles and railcars, object counts and classification” across multiple locations. The contract focuses on “laying the groundwork for identifying trends and anomalies,” according to the company.
The Luno program marks a change in how intelligence agencies work with the private sector. Rather than simply purchasing imagery, NGA is now asking companies to provide analytical reports about activities in specific locations over set time periods, leaving vendors to determine the best methods for collecting and analyzing the necessary data.
This approach has created new opportunities for companies like Maxar and competitors like BlackSky, which announced a $24 million, four-year Luno A task order on June 24 for global monitoring of military and economic facilities.

data.title: Scientists discover unknown organelle inside our cells
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 科学家在细胞内发现了一种未知的细胞器，称为“半融合体”（hemifusome）。这一发现由弗吉尼亚大学和美国国立卫生研究院的研究团队通过低温电子断层扫描技术（cryo-ET）实现。半融合体在细胞内负责协助囊泡的形成及细胞内物质的分类、回收和废物处理。该细胞器对理解某些遗传疾病，如Hermansky-Pudlak综合征等，具有重要意义。这些疾病与细胞内物质处理障碍有关。研究人员希望通过进一步研究半融合体，探索其在健康和疾病中的作用，进而开发针对遗传疾病的新疗法。相关研究发表在《Nature Communications》期刊上。

Cryo-electron tomography observation of hemifused vesicles at the leading edge of cultured cells. Credit:
Nature Communications
(2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-59887-9
The discovery of an unknown organelle inside our cells could open the door to new treatments for devastating inherited diseases.
The
organelle
, a type of specialized structure, has been dubbed a "hemifusome" by its discoverers at the University of Virginia School of Medicine and the National Institutes of Health. This little organelle has a big job helping our cells sort, recycle and discard important cargo within themselves, the scientists say. The new discovery could help scientists better understand what goes wrong in genetic conditions that disrupt these essential housekeeping functions.
"This is like discovering a new recycling center inside the cell," said researcher Seham Ebrahim, Ph.D., of UVA's Department of Molecular Physiology and Biological Physics. "We think the hemifusome helps manage how cells package and process material, and when this goes wrong, it may contribute to diseases that affect many systems in the body."
One such condition is Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome, a
rare genetic disorder
that can cause albinism,
vision problems
, lung disease and issues with blood clotting. Problems with how cells handle cargo are at the root of many such disorders.
"We're just beginning to understand how this new organelle fits into the bigger picture of cell health and disease," Ebrahim said. "It's exciting because finding something truly new inside cells is rare—and it gives us a whole new path to explore."
Tomographic reconstruction of direct hemifusome in a COS-7 cell. Direct hemifusome in a COS-7 cell reveal a dense structure embedded within the hydrophobic interior of the bilayers at the junction of HD and two heterotypic vesicles. Video is displayed at 24 fps. Scale bar: 100 nm. Credit:
Nature Communications
(2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-59887-9
Hello to the hemifusome
Ebrahim and her team at UVA Health worked with Bechara Kachar, MD, and colleagues Amirrasoul Tavakoli, Ph.D., and Shiqiong Hu, Ph.D., at the National Institutes of Health to identify the organelle, which comes and goes as needed by the cell. They took advantage of UVA's expertise in
cryo-electron tomography
(cryo-ET)—a powerful imaging method that "freezes" cells in time—to create striking images of the organelle.
The scientists believe hemifusomes facilitate the formation of vesicles, tiny blister-like sacs that act as mixing bowls, and of organelles made up of multiple vesicles. This process is critical to cellular sorting, recycling and debris disposal, the researchers report.
"You can think of vesicles like little delivery trucks inside the cell," said Ebrahim, of UVA's Center for Membrane and Cell Physiology. "The hemifusome is like a loading dock where they connect and transfer cargo. It's a step in the process we didn't know existed."
While the hemifusomes have escaped detection until now, the scientists say they are surprisingly common in certain parts of our cells. The researchers are eager to better understand their importance to proper cellular function and learn how problems with them could be contributing to disease. Such insights, they say, could lead to targeted treatments for a range of serious genetic disorders.
"This is just the beginning," Ebrahim said. "Now that we know hemifusomes exist, we can start asking how they behave in healthy cells and what happens when things go wrong. That could lead us to new strategies for treating complex genetic diseases."
The researchers have
published
their findings in the journal
Nature Communications
.
More information:

Nature Communications
(2025).

On LinkedIn,
you can play
a variant of the
N-Queens
problem. A community version of the game (rather, puzzle) can be found
here
.
Recently, we saw it solved using
SAT solvers
, using
SMT Solvers

APL
and
MiniZinc
. Today, I will try solving it using Haskell, a slightly more conventional language.
The Puzzle
You are given a N-colored square-shaped board of size N. You must place N queens on the board such that:
Each row, each column, and each color region has exactly one queen.
No two queens touch each other diagonally.
Note that placing two queens in the same diagonal is acceptable, as long as they are not diagonally adjacent (unlike in Chess).
For instance, one can verify that the following is the only solution for the given colored board.

Backtracking, Soundness and Completeness

We will tackle the problem using a backtracking approach. This means, we will place a queen on a plausible cell on the board; check if the current configuration can be extended to a full solution; continue if so, and
backtrack
otherwise, finding a different plausible cell to put the queen on.
To aid our discussion, let us introduce some terminology.
A
partial placement
is a set of positions on the board.
A partial placement is
sound
if it does not violate any of the constraints of the problem, i.e., no two queens are in the same row, column, color region, or are diagonally adjacent. We usually refer to such placements as
partial solutions
.
If a partial placement has N queens, it is
complete
.
A partial solution
p

q
if
p
has all the queens placed in
q
, and possibly more.
We can describe our backtracking algorithm using this terminology. The algorithm maintains a partial solution. It extends the partial solution by placing additional queens at each step, until enough queens have been placed (i.e, the solution is
complete
). At the end, we check to see if the solution is also sound. One can see that a sound and complete partial solution solves the given problem, in the sense defined in the previous section.

We encode our backtracking computations using
MonadLogic
monads from the
LogicT
library. This is a generalization of the list monad,
which can be used to
encode non-deterministic (i.e, branching) computation. Since
LogicT
is a monad transformer rather than a monad (like the list monad), it can also be composed with other monadic effects. The
LogicT
library also provides a few additional sophisticated ways of weaving together non-deterministic computations: it makes available
interleave
, a
fair
disjunction, which guarantees that the second computation will make progress even if the first computation is non-terminating. This can also be useful in some cases even if the computations are finite, since an interleaved exploration strategy wouldn’t have to exhaust the first branch before exploring the second one. and

data.author: PaulHoule

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Amoeba分布式操作系统的历史、技术特点及未来发展的讨论

不同观点：
• [sampo] 提到Amoeba项目的历史背景，特别是Andrew S. Tanenbaum在1992年发表的“LINUX is obsolete”言论，并引用了Tanenbaum对Amoeba和UNIX仿真器的描述。他还提供了相关维基百科链接，进一步介绍了Tanenbaum与Torvalds的争论。

• [haunter] 对Amoeba项目表示兴趣，特别是其与Python语言的渊源。他提到Amoeba的源代码存档，并提供了网页存档和GitHub镜像链接，显示出对该项目技术复活的可能性感兴趣。

• [imglorp] 提出分布式操作系统研究是否会在当前基础设施进步的背景下复兴的问题，并特别提到Kubernetes等现代技术可能需要新的想法和灵感。

• [api] 认为过去分布式系统的研究被放弃了很可惜，提到Mosix、OpenMosix、Beowulf等类似项目，并讨论了分布式OS的优缺点。他还提出了无服务器架构可能是一个更好的架构选择，认为这种架构可以消除传统系统的复杂性。

• [killerstorm] 关注Amoeba系统的安全性，特别提到48位数字在暴力破解方面的安全性假设。

• [KingOfCoders] 个人回忆，提到Amoeba项目与自己硕士考试相关，带有怀旧性质。

• [sodimel] 对Guido van Rossum曾参与Amoeba项目表示惊讶，突显出该项目在技术史上的有趣联系。

补充讨论：
• 技术复活的可能性：[haunter] 和 [imglorp] 都提到了Amoeba及其类似项目在现代环境中复活的潜力，特别是在虚拟机和现代基础设施上的可行性。

• 分布式OS的优缺点：[api] 详细讨论了分布式OS的优势（如硬件扩展性）和缺点（如硬件一致性问题、跨地理分布的挑战），并与现代无服务器架构进行了对比。

争议焦点：
• 分布式OS的未来：[imglorp] 和 [api] 对分布式OS在现代计算环境中的适用性和未来发展存在潜在分歧，一个看好其复兴，另一个则指出其固有的复杂性和局限性。

• 安全性的假设：[killerstorm] 对Amoeba系统中48位数字的安全性提出了质疑，这在技术上是一个需要进一步讨论和验证的点。

• nonethewiser：提到另一款相似但极为简单的游戏"Timeline"，并给出链接，认为其无入门门槛。
• neuronflux：表示享受游戏，但引述女友对游戏中表情符号反馈不佳，认为不如Wordle宽容。
• mrgoldenbrown：认为该游戏像是电子版的卡牌游戏Chronology，并提到Chronology作为派对游戏的优点，包括易于解释和可合作游戏。
• pmontra：猜测游戏是否受启发于2022年的桌游"Trekking Through History"，并指出游戏域名创建于2024年11月。
• xnx：更喜欢从左到右的时间线设计，相比纽约时报的从下到上设计更为赞赏。
• Artooooour：遇到错误提示，但发现给出的两个事件已经是按时间顺序排列的，带有幽默感。
• stuartjohnson12：初始提示令人困惑，误将魏玛恶性通货膨胀事件排在中国文化大革命之前，导致错误答案，认为可能是自身技能问题。
• maskinberg：分享了自己的游戏成绩和链接。
• fournes3：建议制作对数版本的时间线游戏，并给出相关链接供参考。
• rateofclimb：建议游戏结束后每个事件能链接到维基百科条目，以便玩家了解更多信息。
• wavemode：完成了36/36，但其中两次是幸运猜测，建议可以设计成类似Wordle的多次尝试模式，以最少次数排序正确为优胜。

补充讨论：
- 游戏命名方式的调侃和批评（NoboruWataya）。
- 用户界面的可用性问题（zdc1）。
- 与其他类似游戏（Timeline、Chronology、Trekking Through History）的比较（nonethewiser、mrgoldenbrown、pmontra）。
- 时间线事件准确性和潜在混淆问题（NoboruWataya、stuartjohnson12）。
- 游戏设计改进建议，如对数时间线和更多互动（fournes3、rateofclimb、wavemode）。

data.author: xeonmc
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：通过删除或简化代码实现代码质量和效率的提升

不同观点：
• **通过删除大量代码实现优化**：[bironran] 分享了通过删除6万行代码并用更简洁的算法替代，从而实现性能优化的经历。这一观点强调了通过算法改进而非增加代码来解决问题。[runfaster2000] 也提到了通过删除代码（C#和WinRT互操作支持）来实现系统优化，但这是一个破坏性变更。

• **删除代码提高代码质量**：[jfengel] 描述了在大学期间删除大量低质量代码（Turbo Pascal）的经历，指出删除不必要的代码可以显著提高代码质量。这一观点强调了代码质量而非仅仅代码数量的问题。

• **历史讨论与其他实例**：[dang] 提供了多个关于“删除2000行代码”的历史讨论链接，认为这些讨论对新一代开发者有教育意义，并强调了重复发布在一定时间后是可以接受的。

• **对开发者奖励机制的批评**：[abraxas] 引用了一个Dilbert漫画的例子，批评了按修复的bug数量给予奖励的机制，暗示这种做法可能导致不良的开发行为。

• **对LLMs提高生产力的质疑**：[conartist6] 对LLMs（大型语言模型）提高开发者生产力的说法持怀疑态度，暗示这种生产力提升可能并不真实。

• **有害的开发者绩效指标**：[vodou] 分享了一个关于开发者绩效指标（修复和引发bug的数量）的负面例子，并描述了如何通过巧妙的方式废除这个指标，强调了不当指标可能对开发者造成的压力和困扰。

• **删除同事代码的感受**：[ivanjermakov] 描述了删除同事两个月贡献的代码的经历，并表示这带来了极大的满足感。

• **代码量最小化的观点**：[kunley] 引用了“每行不写的代码都是正确的”这一观点，强调了减少代码量的重要性。[Arch-TK] 也分享了正在努力简化和缩小代码的经历，并指出保持代码简洁和小型化的重要性。

• **负代码行数的自豪感**：[fathomdeez] 表示自己在两家公司工作期间代码行数为负增长，并对此感到自豪，强调了删除和优化代码的价值。

• **对故事真实性的质疑**：[bearjaws] 对某些故事的真实性提出了质疑，特别是关于“然后他们再也不问他了”的情节，暗示这些故事可能是编造的。

补充讨论：
• 代码质量与数量的关系是讨论的核心，多个评论强调了删除不必要代码和优化算法的重要性。
• 对开发者绩效指标和奖励机制的批评反映了开发社区对不当管理实践的关注。
• 对LLMs提高生产力的质疑表明了技术社区中对新兴技术影响的审慎态度。
• 故事真实性的争议显示了对网络故事和个人经历分享的信任问题。

data.author: esher
data.article_summary: 《The Offline Club》倡导远离屏幕、享受线下生活。他们举办各种数字戒毒静修、商务活动和线下聚会，帮助人们放松、交流和建立真实联系。俱乐部已在多个城市设立分会，如阿姆斯特丹、伦敦、巴黎等，并计划扩展到更多地方。参与者可以通过加入当地等待名单或申请成为城市领袖来启动新分会。俱乐部还提供周末静修活动，让人远离日常繁忙和数字干扰。此外，他们发布《The Offline Times》新闻通讯，分享灵感与建议，并定期举办全球24小时数字戒毒挑战。用户评价极高，4.7分（基于251条评论）。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于“The Offline Club”及其与类似平台（如Meetup）的对比，讨论其可行性、目标市场以及活动组织的挑战。

不同观点：
• **[apgwoz]**：认为The Offline Club与Meetup有相似之处，但也有不同，如不围绕特定主题，而是强调“离线”一起活动。提出活动组织的五个主要挑战，包括寻找活动空间和确保参与者出席等。
• **[larrymyers]**：指出本地游戏商店已经提供了类似的离线活动，如桌游和卡牌游戏比赛，且这些活动通常禁止使用设备，因此自然实现“离线”。
• **[yesfitz]**：认为The Offline Club有一个特定的市场需求，特别是对于那些有屏幕成瘾问题的人。支付入场费可以给参与者一种责任感，促使他们参加活动。同时提到技能型活动可能不适合所有人。
• **[kilroy123]**：指出The Offline Club的网站实际上嵌入了另一个平台（https://lu.ma/），并对此表示讽刺。
• **[edent]**：质疑支付12.50英镑仅为了在沉默中阅读的合理性，认为这不符合其价值。
• **[ethagnawl]**：对The Offline Club表示欢迎，认为它类似于没有WeWork包袱的Meetup，并分享了自己在Meetup上的积极社交经验。
• **[tonymet]**：对通过日程、清单和数据库等方式安排社交活动持怀疑态度，认为真正的社交关系应该是 spontaneous（自发的），而不是通过计划实现的。

补充讨论：
• **[booleandilemma]**：简单提到网站已上线。
• **[PolyBaker]**：幽默地指出这是一个在线文章讨论离线活动。
• **[_rpxpx]**：提供了一个类似组织的链接（https://www.theludditeclub.org/）。
• **[GuinansEyebrows]**：标记了一条评论（具体原因未说明）。

争议焦点：
• **活动组织的挑战**：包括活动空间、参与者出席率、组织者持续性等实际问题。
• **社交关系的自发性与计划性**：[tonymet]认为社交应该是 spontaneous 的，而计划性的活动反而会失去吸引力。其他用户则认为有组织的活动可以帮助那些不擅长社交的人。
• **活动的价值**：如[edent]对支付高额费用参加简单活动的合理性提出质疑。

总结：讨论主要围绕The Offline Club的定位、市场需求、活动组织的实际挑战以及社交活动的自发性与计划性之间的争议。不同的评论者根据自己的经验和观察提供了支持或反对的观点，并提出了一些实际的建议和例子。

data.author: robinhouston
data.article_summary: 数学家们近日成功构建了一种特殊的四面体，其特点是无论怎样放置，总会翻转到同一侧面朝下并保持稳定。这一成果验证了约翰·康威在1966年提出的猜想，即通过不均匀的重量分布，可以制造出仅在一个面上稳定的四面体。这一形状由Gábor Domokos及其研究团队设计，并由轻质碳纤维和致密的碳化钨制成，精度要求极高。该发现不仅解决了多年来的数学难题，还展示了在几何和工程领域中对平衡问题的新理解。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对非均匀质量多面体（"刀刃"平衡）的可能性和应用的讨论

不同观点：
• [ChuckMcM] 提出了一种非均匀质量的多面体概念，具备两种稳定状态：一种是不太稳定的状态，另一种是非常稳定的状态。如果受到扰动，它会从不稳定状态切换到稳定状态，并认为这种结构可以用于防篡探测。

• [kazinator] 指出这种多面体与Gömböc（一种均匀密度的自校正物体）不同，后者的质量分布是均匀的，而ChuckMcM提到的结构则依赖于非均匀密度，大部分质量集中在底部。

• [mosura] 对该结构需要极大密度变化表示失望，并提出疑问：为什么不能通过3D打印带孔的单一材料来实现，而非要依赖密度变化。

• [pizzathyme] 和 [yobid20] 提出了类似的替代方案，即通过一个带有加权平面的球体来实现同样的效果，这样物体每次都会以相同的方式落地。这表明他们认为简单的加权设计可能比复杂的多面体结构更有效。

补充讨论：
• [boznz] 和 [WillPostForFood] 以幽默的方式建议将这种多面体形状用于月球着陆器设计，暗示其在航天领域的潜在应用。

• [a_imho] 分享了一个Gömböcs在行动的视频链接，将讨论引回Gömböc及其特性。

• [tbeseda] 以幽默的方式提到了Vans挑战，将讨论稍微带离了主题。

• [bradleyy] 和 [Retr0id] 表达了对实际模型和3D模型的兴趣，尤其是对标出质心的模型。

• [strangattractor] 用幽默的方式指出该多面体形状像猫，增加了讨论的趣味性。

• [devenson] 强调了简单发明仍然有其可能性，呼应了ChuckMcM提出的简单但创新的概念。

争议焦点：
• 争议的焦点在于是否需要复杂的非均匀质量多面体设计，还是通过简单的加权球体即可实现同样的效果。这涉及到设计的复杂性和实用性之间的平衡。

A New Pyramid-Like Shape Always Lands the Same Side Up
By
Elise Cutts
June 25, 2025
A tetrahedron is the simplest Platonic solid. Mathematicians have now made one that’s stable only on one side, confirming a decades-old conjecture.
Comment
Save Article
Read Later
This shape can only rest on one of its four sides.
Gábor Domokos
Introduction
By
Elise Cutts
Contributing Writer
June 25, 2025
View PDF/Print Mode
engineering
geometry
mathematics
All topics
In 360 BCE, Plato envisioned the cosmos as an arrangement of five geometric shapes: flat-sided solids called polyhedra. These immediately became important objects of mathematical study. So it might be surprising that, millennia later, mysteries still surround even the simplest shape in Plato’s polyhedral universe: the tetrahedron, which has just four triangular faces.
One major open problem, for instance, asks how densely you can pack “regular” tetrahedra, which have identical faces. Another asks which kinds of tetrahedra can be sliced into pieces that can then be reassembled to form a cube.
The great mathematician
John Conway
was interested not only in how tetrahedra can be arranged or rearranged, but also in how they balance. In 1966, he and the mathematician Richard Guy asked whether it was possible to construct a tetrahedron made of a uniform material — with its weight evenly distributed — that can only sit on one of its faces. If you were to place such a “monostable” shape on any of its other faces, it would always flip to its stable side.
A few years later, the duo answered their own question, showing that this uniform monostable tetrahedron wasn’t possible. But what if you were allowed to distribute its weight unevenly?
At first, it might seem obvious that this should work. “After all, this is how roly-poly toys work: Just put a heavy weight in the bottom,” said
Dávid Papp
of North Carolina State University. But “this only works with shapes that are smooth or round or both.” When it comes to polyhedra, with their sharp edges and flat faces, it’s not clear how to design something that will always flip to the same side.
Gábor Domokos discovers and builds new shapes to understand the world around us.
Ákos Stiller
Conway, for his part, thought that such tetrahedra should exist, as some mathematicians recall him saying. But he ended up focusing on the balancing acts of higher-dimensional, uniformly weighted tetrahedra. If he ever wrote up a proof of his off-the-cuff 3D conjecture, he never published it.
And so for decades, mathematicians didn’t really think about the problem. Then along came
Gábor Domokos
, a mathematician at the Budapest University of Technology and Economics who had long been preoccupied with balancing problems. In 2006, he and one of his colleagues discovered a shape called the gömböc, which has the unusual property of being “mono-monostatic” — it balances on just two points (one stable, the other unstable, like the side of a coin), and no others. Try to balance it anywhere else, and it will roll over to stand on its stable point.
But like a roly-poly, the gömböc is round in places. Domokos wanted to know if a pointy polyhedron could have a similar property. And so Conway’s conjecture intrigued him. “How was it possible that there was an utterly simple statement about an utterly simple object, and yet the answer was far from immediate?” he said. “I knew that this was very likely a treasure.”
In 2023, Domokos — along with his graduate students Gergő Almádi and Krisztina Regős, and
Robert Dawson
of Saint Mary’s University in Canada — proved that it is indeed possible to distribute a tetrahedron’s weight so that it will sit on just one face. At least in theory.
But Almádi, Dawson and Domokos wanted to build the thing, a task that turned out to be far more challenging than they expected. Now, in a preprint posted online yesterday, they have presented the
first working physical model
of the shape. The tetrahedron, which weighs 120 grams and measures 50 centimeters along its longest side, is made of lightweight carbon fiber and dense tungsten carbide. To work, it had to be engineered to a level of precision within one-tenth of a gram and one-tenth of a millimeter. But the final construction always flip-flops onto one face, exactly as it should.

data.title: Writing a basic Linux device driver when you know nothing about Linux drivers
data.author: sbt567
data.article_summary: 文章主要描述了作者尝试为Nanoleaf Pegboard Desk Dock开发Linux驱动程序的过程。该设备原本只支持Windows和macOS系统，作者通过在Windows虚拟机中进行USB直通和逆向工程官方驱动，尝试了解设备协议。意外的是，Nanoleaf技术支持快速提供了详细的协议文档。作者利用这些信息，结合Linux系统中的`lsusb`工具，分析设备描述符和接口信息，发现Linux内核已为该设备分配了一个基础驱动，但功能有限。文章进一步介绍了USB设备的基本知识，并计划基于逆向工程的协议开发完整的Linux驱动。最终，作者提供了相关代码链接，并继续探索开发过程。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源协议和技术支持的开放性，Rust语言的使用，用户空间驱动程序的实现细节，以及不同操作系统下的驱动开发挑战。

• **用户空间驱动程序的实现问题**：kblissett对生产环境中的用户空间驱动程序的实现步骤表示好奇，询问是否通常是通过守护进程在启动时运行，并通过socket与配置GUI通信。

• **对文章写作风格的评价**：dabedee赞赏文章的写作方式，包括代码、运行过程和错误路径，认为能让读者感受到作者的探索过程。shreddit则以幽默的方式表示对文章中重新运行测试的理解。

• **操作系统兼容性与驱动开发的挑战**：0xbadcafebee提到希望在笔记本上运行FreeBSD，但由于wifi卡驱动不完整，考虑使用AI编码助手来协助开发驱动，但因为AI工具的复杂性而犹豫。

• **开源项目的贡献建议**：LorenDB认为作者应该在OpenRGB中实现支持，以便更好地造福他人，但同时也承认当前的实现已经很酷。

• **Rust语言的使用**：部分用户如fracus对需要学习Rust表示犹豫，而其他用户如ianlevesque则对Rust实现表示赞赏，这反映了不同用户对编程语言的偏好和接受程度。

• **开源贡献与个人项目**：LorenDB建议作者将支持实现贡献到OpenRGB项目中以造福更多人，但其他用户如ahartmetz则对作者当前的实现表示赞赏，显示出对开源贡献的不同期望。

A couple of months ago I bought the
Nanoleaf Pegboard Desk Dock
, the latest and greatest in USB-hub-with-RGB-LEDs-and-hooks-for-gadgets technology. This invention unfortunately only supports the
real gamer
operating systems of Windows and macOS, which necessitated the development of a Linux driver.
Over the past few posts Iâve set up a
Windows VM with USB passthrough
, and attempted to
reverse-engineer the official drivers
,  As I was doing that, I also thought Iâd message the vendor and ask them if they could share any specifications or docs regarding their protocol. To my surprise, Nanoleaf tech support responded to me within 4 hours, with a full description of the protocol thatâs used both by the Desk Dock as well as their RGB strips. The docs mostly confirmed what I had already discovered independently, but there were a couple of other minor features as well (like power and brightness management) that I did not know about, which was helpful.
Today, weâre going to take a crack at writing a driver based on the (reverse-engineered) protocol, while also keeping
the official documentation
at hand. One small problem, though: Iâve never written a Linux device driver before, nor interacted with any USB device as anything else but a user.
Skip to the good part?
Lots of yapping ahead. If you just want to see the code,
click here
.
Starting from scratch
Most Linux distros ship with
lsusb
, a simple utility that will enumerate all USB devices connected to the system. Since I had no clue where to start from, I figured I might as well run this to see if the device appears in the listing.
$ lsusb
<snip>
Bus 001 Device 062: ID 37fa:8201 JW25021301515 Nanoleaf Pegboard Desk Dock

The kernel (presumably) has no knowledge of this deviceâs existence, yet the second I plug it in to my computer it receives power, turns on and gets identified by the kernel.
As it turns out, we actually already have a driver! Itâs just a very stupid one. If we run
lsusb
in verbose mode and request the information just for this specific device, we will get a lot more details about it:

• **赞赏技术支持的开放性**：ahartmetz对Nanoleaf技术支持迅速提供协议描述表示赞赏，认为这种开放性非常酷，而许多厂商通常认为共享规格会帮助竞争对手。

• **Rust语言的兴趣与质疑**：ianlevesque对Rust实现的用户空间USB HID驱动表示兴趣，认为比内核驱动更适用。fracus则表示希望这是用C语言实现的，以避免学习Rust，但同时也承认可能是时候学习Rust了。

• **用户空间驱动程序的实现问题**：kblissett对生产环境中的用户空间驱动程序的实现步骤表示好奇，询问是否通常是通过守护进程在启动时运行，并通过socket与配置GUI通信。

• **对文章写作风格的评价**：dabedee赞赏文章的写作方式，包括代码、运行过程和错误路径，认为能让读者感受到作者的探索过程。shreddit则以幽默的方式表示对文章中重新运行测试的理解。

• **操作系统兼容性与驱动开发的挑战**：0xbadcafebee提到希望在笔记本上运行FreeBSD，但由于wifi卡驱动不完整，考虑使用AI编码助手来协助开发驱动，但因为AI工具的复杂性而犹豫。

• **开源项目的贡献建议**：LorenDB认为作者应该在OpenRGB中实现支持，以便更好地造福他人，但同时也承认当前的实现已经很酷。

补充讨论：
• **读者反馈与启发**：jonnypotty对文章表示感谢，认为文章有趣且具有启发性。

• **Rust语言的使用**：部分用户如fracus对需要学习Rust表示犹豫，而其他用户如ianlevesque则对Rust实现表示赞赏，这反映了不同用户对编程语言的偏好和接受程度。

• **开源贡献与个人项目**：LorenDB建议作者将支持实现贡献到OpenRGB项目中以造福更多人，但其他用户如ahartmetz则对作者当前的实现表示赞赏，显示出对开源贡献的不同期望。

data.title: LLM Hallucinations in Practical Code Generation
data.author: appwiz
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：大型语言模型（LLM）的幻觉问题及其解决方案

不同观点：
• [imiric] 认为当前AI公司过于追求基准测试和增值产品，而忽视了对基础问题的研究。RAG（检索-增强-生成）方法虽然在缓解幻觉问题上有一定作用，但很有限，因为它依赖于用户提供的真实数据，且在大多数事实性信息场景中不适用。直接依赖网络数据不可行，因为需要人工审查来源，这非常耗费人力。因此，RAG只是权宜之计，幻觉问题需要更基础的解决方案。

• [nerdjon] 分享了实际使用中的例子，指出在生成IAM策略时，模型会基于对键名的预期产生幻觉，导致错误或不存在的键，尤其是在处理更复杂条件时。

• [cryptica] 认为LLM的幻觉是由于训练集中的矛盾造成的，类似于人类在学习过程中如果没有仔细解决知识中的矛盾，就会犯类似的错误。提出了一种训练方法：从高质量、少矛盾的基础主题开始，逐步扩展知识，并在遇到矛盾时进行处理或标注，甚至考虑通过另一个神经网络来监控和回滚矛盾的训练。

• [th0ma5] 认为文章很好地讨论了在没有真实数据支持下解决问题所面临的挑战，并指出人们开发了多种方法来应对信息缺失问题，尽管在某些基准测试中改进有限。

• [dheera] 持相对乐观的态度，认为LLM幻觉出不存在的Python库有时可能意味着这个库值得被创造出来，具有一定的积极意义。

• [simonw] 认为生成的代码中的幻觉问题并不严重，因为一旦运行代码，错误会立即显现，而且当前的编码代理系统通常由LLM自身发现并纠正错误。对文章更多讨论RAG解决方案而非工具使用解决方案感到意外。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于幻觉问题的严重性及其解决方案。Imiric和simonw对幻觉问题的影响程度有不同看法，前者认为需要根本性解决方案，后者则认为影响不大且能自我纠正。
• Cryptica提出了一个详细的训练方法，试图从根本上减少幻觉问题，但其实施复杂性和有效性尚待验证。
• 不同用户分享了实际使用中的具体例子（如nerdjon的IAM策略生成），展示了幻觉问题在实际应用中的表现和影响。

总结来看，讨论围绕LLM幻觉问题的本质、影响以及潜在解决方案展开，各方对问题的严重性和解决路径有不同见解。

data.title: Coccinelle for Rust progress report
data.author: mfilion
data.article_summary:
Tathagata Roy分享了CoccinelleforRust项目的进展，该项目旨在将Coccinelle工具引入Rust代码库。Coccinelle最初用于Linux内核的大规模C代码修改，通过语义补丁自动进行代码匹配和转换。随着Rust在系统软件中的应用增加，CoccinelleforRust项目致力于为Rust提供类似功能。

项目自2024年起取得多项进展，包括开发CTL引擎（使用RefCell和哈希表优化性能）、自定义SmPL解析器（结合Rust语法和Rust Analyzer工具），以及支持代码转换规则的继承。然而，规则依赖性尚未实现。此外，Rust的表达式密集型语法使得匹配和转换比C更加复杂，例如Rust中块可以作为表达式出现，增加了计算复杂性。为解决此问题，项目进行了多项优化。

示例展示了如何使用语义补丁自动修改Rust代码中的函数调用和参数，显著提升了代码修改效率。

Coccinelle for Rust progress report
Tathagata Roy
June 25, 2025
Share this post:
Reading time:
In collaboration with Inria (the French Institute for Research in Computer Science and Automation), Tathagata Roy shares the progress made over the past year on the CoccinelleForRust project, co-sponsored by Collabora.
Coccinelle is a tool for automatic program matching and transformation that was originally developed for making large-scale changes to the Linux kernel source code (i.e., C code). Matches and transformations are driven by user-specific transformation rules in the form of abstracted patches, referred to as
semantic patches
. As the Linux kernel—and systems software more generally—is starting to adopt Rust, we are developing
Coccinelle for Rust
to make the power of Coccinelle available to Rust codebases.
Example usage
This diff
illustrates a patch in which the
type_of
function was being called
before
confirming that the target item’s trait was implemented. A straightforward CfR-based fix is to find every expression of the form
expression.type_of(impl_id)
and replace it with
expression.type_of(impl_id).subst_identity()
There are roughly fifty occurrences of this pattern in the diff, so updating them all by hand would be quite tedious. The accompanying Semantic Patch to perform this transformation automatically is:
@change_ty_of@
expression exp1, impl_id;
@@
-exp1.type_of(impl_id)
+exp1.type_of(impl_id).subst_identity()
While the above example could be achieved with a complicated and unreadable regex pattern, things can quickly become more complex.
The following patch changes a function signature and all the related calls.
@change_sig@
expression x;
identifier fname, sname;
@@
impl sname {
...
pub(crate) fn fname(&self,
-       guard: &RevocableGuard<'_>
) -> Result { ... }
...
}
@modify_calls@
expression x, guard;
identifier change_sig.fname;
@@
x.fname(
...
-   guard
)
Rule
change_sig
finds all the occurrences of functions which take a
guard
of type
&RevocableGuard<'_>
and removes that parameter. The rule
modify_calls
updates the calls to that method.
This semantic patch can be used on a whole code-base where once a
guard
variable is no longer needed, it can be removed. It can also serve as an integration test to check that no such code is present in new pull requests.
Developments (2024–Present)
CTL Engine
Core pattern-matching engine using CTL.
Shared with C version, adapted for Rust’s expression-heavy syntax.
Performance optimized with
RefCell
s and hash tables.
SmPL Parsing
SmPL includes Rust + custom syntax (
..
,
+
,
-
, disjunctions).
Custom parser for SmPL constructs; uses Rust Analyzer for Rust code.
Rules
Define code transformations scoped to an environment.
Support for rule inheritance.
Rule dependencies not yet implemented.
Language Features
Ellipses (
...
)
Connects code segments within the same control flow.
Uses CTL
AU
.
Higher complexity due to Rust’s flexible syntax.
Note:
... when
not yet supported.
Disjunctions
Alternative code match options.
Can combine with ellipses for complex patterns.
Developments in detail: 2024–Present
CTL Engine
Computational Tree Logic (CTL) is the heart of Coccinelle, which takes semantic patches and generalizes them over Rust files. Prior to using this engine, CfR used an ad-hoc method for matching patterns of code. This engine is the same as the one used for Coccinelle for C, with a few minor changes. Most of the changes were idiomatic but to the same effect. More information on the engine and its language (CTL-VW) can be found in the
POPL Paper
. With a standard engine, each step of the matching process can be logged, allowing us to learn and reuse the same design patterns from Coccinelle for C, including critical test cases.
The expression-dominated nature of Rust makes the matching and transformation process a bit different from that of C. For example, in the following semantic patch:
@@
expression e
@@
-foo(e);
for C,
foo(e)
would be guaranteed to be present as an immediate child of a block, i.e.:
{           // <- start of a block
foo(e); // <- this statement
}
Blocks in C are present only in specific parts of the Abstract Syntax Tree, like in function definitions, loops, or conditional blocks. However, in Rust, blocks are expressions, which can appear anywhere an expression is allowed. For example:
while { f(&mut a); a > 1 } {
//
}
This makes searching much more computationally intensive. Thus, several optimizations were implemented in CfR to address this problem, including replacing lists in the CTL engine with
RefCell
s and hash tables.

data.title: Microsoft Dependency Has Risks
data.author: ArcHound
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了微软依据美国制裁政策封锁国际刑事法院（ICC）一名官员邮箱的事件，引发了对依赖微软产品的组织可能面临风险的担忧。作者分析了此类事件再次发生的可能性及其潜在成本，提出企业应投资于预防措施。文章提到，尽管部分消息来源证实了封锁事件，微软和ICC均未进一步说明细节。作者强调，在当前美国政治环境下，制裁具有不可预测性，企业需考虑这种风险对其业务连续性的影响。最后，文章建议通过“安全投资回报计算”来理性评估应对此类风险的成本和措施。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对微软及美国科技公司的依赖与风险

不同观点：
• **微软产品有其独特价值，但需区分优劣**：[bob1029] 认为微软作为一个大型多样化组织，某些产品如.NET、MSSQL、Visual Studio具有独特优势，尤其在调试和游戏引擎领域无可替代。但同时，Azure和Windows则被视为问题较多。
• **美国政府影响不限于微软**：[jimbobimbo] 指出，所有美国公司都面临同样的政府要求问题，微软并非特例，因此无需单独针对微软。
• **全球化逆转带来的法律风险**：[throwaway48476] 强调，全球化逆转使得跨国公司需遵循本国法律，这带来了新的风险，企业必须考虑这些风险。
• **技术复杂性与对大公司依赖**：[0xWTF] 认为，技术复杂性超出普通用户理解范围，使得依赖大公司如微软变得不可避免。同时，个人运行自有服务器的难度增加，也使得人们更依赖现有的大型服务提供商。
• **迁移成本高昂**：[firesteelrain] 指出，对于大多数企业而言，迁移离开微软的成本和难度远超潜在收益，因此他们选择继续使用微软产品。
• **业务连续性计划与风险缓解**：[1970-01-01] 认为，企业应通过保险等补偿控制来应对风险，而非仅仅依赖单一供应商。
• **对云服务的单点失败担忧**：[hilbert42] 强烈反对依赖微软等公司的云服务，认为这是单点失败，风险极高。
• **对专有软件的质疑**：[jongjong] 无法理解人们为何继续使用专有软件如Windows或OSX，认为这是社会中隐性垄断力量的结果。
• **对政府强制行为的担忧**：[kenjackson] 指出，抵制政府强制行为非常困难，任何公司都可能受到类似影响，微软并非唯一风险。
• **对云计算执行的不透明担忧**：[axus] 对Azure在云端执行代码而非本地执行表示担忧，认为用户可能不了解背后的技术细节。

补充讨论：
• **对微软云服务和政府行为的综合担忧**：[hooverd] 引用了一个近期事件，指出微软可能因政府制裁而封锁特定邮箱，提醒企业需考虑此类风险并进行预防性投资。

争议焦点：
